messages:
alice_ml: onboarding nova-v2-compact (q4) — hitting a reproducible politeness/polite-suffix drop for Korean on our translation evals. anyone seen this with compact quant builds? :eyes:

tao_eng: can you paste a short input/output sample and repro rate?

alice_ml: repro ~86% on polite_test (200 samples). sample:
```
Input: 안녕하세요. 선생님, 오늘 일정 알려주세요.
Expected: 안녕하세요, 선생님. 오늘 일정 알려드릴게요.
nova-v2-q8: 안녕하세요. 선생님, 오늘 일정 알려드릴게요.
nova-v2-q4: 안녕. 너, 오늘 일정 알려줘.
```
(yeah it's brutal) BLEU chrF: 28.4 -> 22.1 (-6.3) / chrF 0.59 -> 0.49

priya_research: interesting — int8 kept the polite forms? that points to tokenizer/detok or subtoken merge in q4 build rather than decoder weights. can you dump token ids around polite suffix?

alice_ml: token dump snippet:
```
# around polite suffix
tokens_q8: [1204, 985, 5021, 3002, 78]  # polite suffix separated
tokens_q4: [1204, 985, 50213002]        # merged id (placeholder showing merge)
```

sam_reviewer: I started a quick bisect, saw tokenizer v3.6 -> v3.7 normalization change (NFKC) landed in staging that touches hangul composition order. commit: `f8c3a9b` — might affect pre-tokenizer.

devops-bot: canary deploy: nova-v2-q4 -> staging (10%) :rocket:

priya_research: running tokenizer debug locally with the exact q4 tokenizer weights now. also trying a patch to force `preserve_hangul_suf=true` in detok rules. running:
```
./tools/tokenizer_debug --model nova-v2-q4 --input samples/polite_ko.txt --dump-ids
```

sam_reviewer: quick thought — could also be quant kernel packing that collapsed adjacent subtokens at certain merges. but the merged id in your dump looks like a tokenizer map problem. I'll check mapping table.

alice_ml: adding this to rollout blockers and flagged KR locale. pinned nova-v2-q8 for KR route for now. @priya_research @sam_reviewer assigning to you both. :thumbsup:

priya_research: +1. initial debug shows the q4 tokenizer vocabulary index table differs by an offset for indexes > 50000. suspect artifact in vocab serialization step of the quantize pipeline. re-running quantize with explicit vocab copy. will report.

sam_reviewer: if we need a short-term mitigation, we can add a locale-specific postprocess that restores polite endings when pattern matches `^(안녕|...).*` but that's messy. prefer root fix.

deploy-bot: canary paused due to quality alert (auto).

alice_ml: thanks all. I've uploaded the failing sample set + seeds to /evals/artifacts/3951234567/polite_ko.json and linked the CI run `ci/3951234567-kr-polite` to the ticket. ping if you want me to run extra bisect variants.

tao_eng: great, keep updates in this thread. if priya confirms vocab serialization bug, let's hold all q4 rollouts for compact models until patch. :warning:

priya_research: update in ~45m — currently re-quantizing with a deterministic vocab write. will post token diffs and a tiny patch. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam_reviewer: noted; will prepare a minimal repro harness so we can run across other locales (JP/KR/JA) quickly.

alice_ml: appreciated. feel free to @me for quick eval runs.

(threads and messages truncated to essentials)
